description: This file defines the {@code Operator} annotation used in TensorFlow Java API for marking classes as TensorFlow operators accessible via {@code org.tensorflow.op.Ops}. It includes documentation and configuration options for how annotated classes are processed and integrated into the API.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Annotation used to mark classes as TensorFlow operators for generating API methods in the {@code Ops} class.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Optional attribute to specify a group within the {@code Ops} class where the operator's method should be placed.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Optional attribute to specify a custom method name in the {@code Ops} class instead of deriving it from the class name.
